description: Prerequisite: caller holds admin rights (is_admin=1 / in-VM permissions==Admin). Effect: sends a ModerationRequest{KICK_USER, EntityId=target_persist_id} on the city socket. Server closes the target's live session (no DB change, no persistent ban). Cost: none. No response PDU; caller assumes success if the handler returns ok=true. Non-admin callers are refused deterministically in the bot handler before any PDU leaves the wire.

args.name: target_persist_id
args.description: avatar_id (Sim persist id) of the user to kick.

call_signatures: cf $CF kick-user --target_persist_id <avatar_id>                                     # admin-only; closes target session (no DB change)
common_mistakes: Calling as non-admin → ok:false ('caller is not an admin').
Kicking yourself → ok:false ('refusing to target self').
target_persist_id is an avatar_id (Sim persist id), not a user_id. Archive ops use user_id instead.
No wire ACK — kicked target's session just closes; verify via find-avatar or absence from nearby_sims.
perception_hints: Target persist_id: perception.nearby_sims[].persist_id (for physically-present targets); other avatars need find-avatar or direct knowledge of avatar_id
Your own persist_id (to avoid self-target): perception.avatar.persist_id
Chat activity you may want to moderate: perception.recent_events[] kind=='chat'
refuse_conditions: caller not admin (VM permissions != Admin) → ok:false with 'caller is not an admin (current_permissions=...)'
target_persist_id == own avatar_id → ok:false with 'refusing to target self'
